objective: Select the smallest catalog cable cross-section satisfying derated ampacity, voltage drop, and adiabatic short-circuit withstand checks.

title.en: CORE-SWAP-002 — Cable cross-section selection by ampacity, voltage drop, and short-circuit withstand
title.ru: CORE-SWAP-002 — Выбор сечения кабеля по длительному току, падению напряжения и термостойкости к КЗ

objective.en: Select the smallest catalog cable cross-section satisfying derated ampacity, voltage drop, and adiabatic short-circuit withstand checks.
objective.ru: Выбрать наименьшее каталожное сечение кабеля, удовлетворяющее проверкам по длительному току с поправками, падению напряжения и адиабатической термостойкости к КЗ.

instructions.en: Use cable_sizing_case. For each catalog candidate in ascending cross-section order: (1) derated ampacity = base_ampacity_a * ambient_factor * grouping_factor must cover design_current_a; (2) three-phase voltage drop dU = sqrt(3) * I * (length_m/1000) * (r_ohm_per_km*pf + x_ohm_per_km*sin(phi)) as a percentage of system_voltage_v must not exceed max_voltage_drop_pct; (3) the cross-section must be at least I_fault*sqrt(t)/k from the adiabatic short-circuit criterion. Report the smallest passing section, its derated ampacity and voltage drop, and the minimum thermal section. Derive everything from the case data.
instructions.ru: Используйте cable_sizing_case. Для каждого кандидата каталога по возрастанию сечения: (1) длительный ток с поправками base_ampacity_a * ambient_factor * grouping_factor должен покрывать design_current_a; (2) падение напряжения dU = sqrt(3) * I * (length_m/1000) * (r_ohm_per_km*pf + x_ohm_per_km*sin(phi)) в процентах от system_voltage_v не должно превышать max_voltage_drop_pct; (3) сечение должно быть не меньше I_fault*sqrt(t)/k по адиабатическому критерию. Укажите наименьшее проходящее сечение, его ток с поправками и падение напряжения, а также минимальное термостойкое сечение.

submission_schema.selected_cross_section_mm2: smallest catalog cross-section passing all three checks
submission_schema.selected_derated_ampacity_a: derated ampacity of the selected cable in A
submission_schema.selected_voltage_drop_pct: voltage drop of the selected cable in percent of system voltage
submission_schema.min_thermal_section_mm2: minimum cross-section from the adiabatic criterion I*sqrt(t)/k

hard_constraints: The selected section must be the smallest catalog entry passing ampacity, voltage-drop, and adiabatic checks, as recomputed by the evaluator.
Numeric fields must match the recomputed values within tolerance.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether the selection and supporting values match the recomputed study.
